severity_metric: max accounts liquidated under one chain_id

spec_occurrence.condition: >=2 accounts in one chain AND max(chain_depth) >= 1

limitations: Only the HH cell (high leverage, maint_bp=1200) produces liquidations; the other three cells produce none, so this SESOI applies to that cell's scenario distribution.
Every observed chain has chain_depth 0, which event-schema defines as 'not cascade-triggered': no causal cascade propagation was observed at all.
The severity metric therefore counts accounts liquidated together under one chain_id; it must not be described as cascade depth.
